name: mydebug-hotreload
description: Save a Java file and see the change in the running application instantly. Spring and MyBatis reload, with or without the debugger.

mydebug.enabled.description: Attach the MyDebug agent to Java launches (Run and Debug). Takes effect on the next launch.

enumDescriptions: Add -XX:+AllowEnhancedClassRedefinition when the launch sets "javaExec" to a JVM that supports it (JetBrains Runtime, DCEVM).
Always add the flag. The JVM must support it, otherwise it will not start.
mydebug.enhancedRedefinition.description: Allow structural changes (adding or removing methods and fields) on JetBrains Runtime.

mydebug.verbose.description: Print agent details to the debug console.

scripts.vscode:prepublish: npm run copy-agent && npm run compile
